sepsis.name: Sepsis / Septic Shock

primaryReferences.citation: Davis AL, Carcillo JA, Aneja RK, et al. American College of Critical Care Medicine Clinical Practice Parameters for Hemodynamic Support of Pediatric and Neonatal Septic Shock. Crit Care Med. 2017;45(6):1061-1093.

Weiss SL, Peters MJ, Alhazzani W, et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign International Guidelines for the Management of Septic Shock and Sepsis-Associated Organ Dysfunction in Children. Pediatr Crit Care Med. 2020;21(2):e52-e106.
Balamuth F, Weiss SL, Neuman MI, et al. Pediatric severe sepsis in US children's hospitals. Pediatr Crit Care Med. 2014;15(9):798-805.

sepsis.reviewNotes: Based on 2017 ACCM parameters updated with 2020 SSC pediatric guidelines. Fluid resuscitation, early antibiotic recommendations, vasopressor algorithms.

rsi.name: RSI / Airway Management

primaryReferences.citation: Nagler J, Bachur RG. Advanced airway management. Curr Opin Pediatr. 2009;21(3):299-305.
Sagarin MJ, Chiang V, Sakles JC, et al. Rapid sequence intubation for pediatric emergency airway management. Pediatr Emerg Care. 2002;18(6):417-423.
AHA/AAP Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) Provider Manual. American Heart Association. 2020.

rsi.reviewNotes: RSI drug dosing per PALS 2020 guidelines. Equipment sizing per Broselow/age-based formulas.

cardiac.name: Cardiac Arrest / Resuscitation

primaryReferences.citation: Topjian AA, Raymond TT, Atkins D, et al. Part 4: Pediatric Basic and Advanced Life Support: 2020 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care. Circulation. 2020;142(16_suppl_2):S469-S523.
de Caen AR, Berg MD, Chameides L, et al. Part 12: Pediatric Advanced Life Support: 2015 AHA Guidelines Update. Circulation. 2015;132(18 Suppl 2):S526-S542.

cardiac.reviewNotes: PALS cardiac arrest algorithm per AHA 2020 guidelines. Epinephrine, amiodarone, defibrillation energy dosing.

seizure.name: Status Epilepticus

primaryReferences.citation: Glauser T, Shinnar S, Gloss D, et al. Evidence-Based Guideline: Treatment of Convulsive Status Epilepticus in Children and Adults. Epilepsy Curr. 2016;16(1):48-61.
Silbergleit R, Durkalski V, Lowenstein D, et al. Intramuscular versus intravenous therapy for prehospital status epilepticus (RAMPART). N Engl J Med. 2012;366(7):591-600.

seizure.reviewNotes: Benzodiazepine-first approach per AES/AAN 2016 guidelines. RAMPART trial supports IM midazolam when IV access unavailable.

respiratory.name: Respiratory Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: Ralston SL, Lieberthal AS, Meissner HC, et al. Clinical Practice Guideline: The Diagnosis, Management, and Prevention of Bronchiolitis. Pediatrics. 2014;134(5):e1474-e1502.
National Asthma Education and Prevention Program Expert Panel Report 3 (EPR-3): Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Asthma. NIH Publication No. 07-4051. 2007.
Bjornson CL, Johnson DW. Croup in children. CMAJ. 2013;185(15):1317-1323.

respiratory.reviewNotes: Covers bronchiolitis (AAP 2014), asthma (NAEPP EPR-3), croup (evidence-based reviews). Scoring systems integrated from respiratory scoring modules.

trauma.name: Trauma / Primary Survey

primaryReferences.citation: American College of Surgeons Committee on Trauma. Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS) Student Course Manual. 10th ed. Chicago, IL: ACS; 2018.
Kuppermann N, Holmes JF, Dayan PS, et al. Identification of children at very low risk of clinically-important brain injuries after head trauma (PECARN). Lancet. 2009;374(9696):1160-1170.

trauma.reviewNotes: ATLS primary/secondary survey framework. PECARN head CT decision rule. Hemorrhage classification and fluid resuscitation.

burns.name: Burns / TBSA

primaryReferences.citation: Romanowski KS, Palmieri TL. Pediatric burn resuscitation: past, present, and future. Burns Trauma. 2017;5:26.
American Burn Association. Advanced Burn Life Support Course Provider Manual. 2018.

burns.reviewNotes: Parkland formula with pediatric modifications. Lund-Browder chart for age-adjusted TBSA. ABA transfer criteria.

metabolic.name: DKA / Metabolic Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: Wolfsdorf JI, Glaser N, Agus M, et al. ISPAD Clinical Practice Consensus Guidelines 2018: Diabetic ketoacidosis and the hyperglycemic hyperosmolar state. Pediatr Diabetes. 2018;19 Suppl 27:155-177.
Kuppermann N, Ghetti S, Schunk JE, et al. Clinical Trial of Fluid Infusion Rates for Pediatric Diabetic Ketoacidosis (PECARN FLUID). N Engl J Med. 2018;378(24):2275-2287.

metabolic.reviewNotes: DKA management per ISPAD 2018 consensus. PECARN FLUID trial informed fluid resuscitation rate recommendations.

toxicology.name: Toxicology / Antidotes

primaryReferences.citation: Mowry JB, Spyker DA, Brooks DE, et al. Annual Report of the American Association of Poison Control Centers' National Poison Data System (NPDS). Clin Toxicol. 2019;57(12):1220-1413.
Brent J, et al. Critical Care Toxicology. 2nd ed. Springer; 2017.

toxicology.reviewNotes: Weight-based antidote dosing. Common pediatric ingestions. Decontamination guidance.

drowning.name: Drowning / Submersion Injury

primaryReferences.citation: Szpilman D, Bierens JJ, Handley AJ, et al. Drowning. N Engl J Med. 2012;366(22):2102-2110.

drowning.reviewNotes: Based on ILCOR consensus and AHA drowning guidelines. Focus on early ventilation, temperature management.

environmental.name: Environmental Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: Zafren K, Giesbrecht GG, Danzl DF, et al. Wilderness Medical Society Practice Guidelines for the Out-of-Hospital Evaluation and Treatment of Accidental Hypothermia. Wilderness Environ Med. 2014;25(4):S66-S85.

environmental.reviewNotes: Heat stroke, hypothermia, envenomation management. WMS guidelines for hypothermia rewarming.

musculoskeletal.name: Musculoskeletal Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: Boutis K, Willan AR, Babyn P, et al. A randomized, controlled trial of a removable brace versus casting in children with low-risk ankle fractures. Pediatrics. 2007;119(6):e1256-e1263.

musculoskeletal.reviewNotes: Fracture management, compartment syndrome recognition, septic arthritis red flags.

skin_infections.name: Skin & Soft Tissue Infections

primaryReferences.citation: Stevens DL, Bisno AL, Chambers HF, et al. Practice guidelines for the diagnosis and management of skin and soft tissue infections: 2014 update by the IDSA. Clin Infect Dis. 2014;59(2):e10-e52.

skin_infections.reviewNotes: IDSA 2014 SSTI guidelines adapted for pediatric populations. Cellulitis, abscess, necrotizing fasciitis.

psychiatric.name: Psychiatric Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: Dolan MA, Fein JA; Committee on Pediatric Emergency Medicine. Pediatric and adolescent mental health emergencies in the emergency medical services system. Pediatrics. 2011;127(5):e1356-e1366.

psychiatric.reviewNotes: Acute agitation management, safety assessment, chemical and physical restraint guidelines.

renal.name: Renal Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: KDIGO AKI Work Group. KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury. Kidney Int Suppl. 2012;2(1):1-138.

renal.reviewNotes: KDIGO AKI staging criteria adapted for pediatrics. UTI management, nephritis recognition.

hematology.name: Hematology Emergencies

primaryReferences.citation: New HV, Byers E, Kidson-Gerber G. Iron deficiency in children and young adults in Australia and New Zealand. J Paediatr Child Health. 2019;55(1):5-10.

hematology.reviewNotes: Transfusion thresholds, anemia workup, bleeding emergencies. AABB transfusion guidelines.

respiratory_scoring.name: Respiratory Scoring Systems

primaryReferences.citation: Ducharme FM, Chalut D, Plotnick L, et al. The Pediatric Respiratory Assessment Measure: a valid clinical score for assessing acute asthma severity from toddlers to teenagers. J Pediatr. 2008;152(4):476-480.
Westley CR, Cotton EK, Brooks JG. Nebulized racemic epinephrine by IPPB for the treatment of croup. Am J Dis Child. 1978;132(5):484-487.

Silverman WA, Andersen DH. A controlled clinical trial of effects of water mist on obstructive respiratory signs, death rate and necropsy findings among premature infants. Pediatrics. 1956;17(1):1-10.

respiratory_scoring.reviewNotes: Validated scoring systems: PRAM, PIS, PASS, MPIS, RDAI, Modified Tal, Westley Croup, Silverman-Andersen, Downes. Each has published validation studies.

acid_base.name: Acid-Base & Electrolyte Calculations

primaryReferences.citation: Berend K, de Vries AP, Gans RO. Physiological approach to assessment of acid-base disturbances. N Engl J Med. 2014;371(15):1434-1445.

acid_base.reviewNotes: Anion gap, delta-delta ratio, ABG interpretation, expected pCO2 calculations.

cardiology_calc.name: Cardiology Calculations

primaryReferences.citation: Park MK. Park's Pediatric Cardiology for Practitioners. 7th ed. Elsevier; 2021.

cardiology_calc.reviewNotes: MAP, cardiac output, QTc, defibrillation energy calculations. ECG reference values by age.

hematology_calc.name: Hematology Calculations

primaryReferences.citation: Roseff SD, Luban NLC, Manno CS. Guidelines for assessing appropriateness of pediatric transfusion. Transfusion. 2002;42(11):1398-1413.

hematology_calc.reviewNotes: CBC indices, reticulocyte production index, MABL, transfusion volume calculations, coagulation assessment.

renal_calc.name: Renal Calculations

primaryReferences.citation: Schwartz GJ, Work DF. Measurement and estimation of GFR in children and adolescents. Clin J Am Soc Nephrol. 2009;4(11):1832-1843.

renal_calc.reviewNotes: Schwartz eGFR, FENa, UPCR, urine output adequacy assessment.

procedures.name: Procedural Guidance

primaryReferences.citation: Henneman PL. Procedures. In: Fleisher & Ludwig's Textbook of Pediatric Emergency Medicine. 8th ed. Wolters Kluwer; 2021.

procedures.reviewNotes: IO access, chest tube, LP, central line procedural guidance. Equipment sizing by age/weight.
